topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Surprise party, my foot. I get to the place, and it’s like a ghost town. Doors shut, lights dim. Someone played me for a patsy. I was supposed to be the guest of honor, or so they said. Walked right into a bait and switch, and I’m the only one holding the empty bag. Words are cheap, but this feels like a setup, plain and simple. Next time, they can keep their surprises. I got eyes, and I ain’t missing a thing. You can bet I’ll be watching the exits.
